title: Inter: five changes expected vs Fiorentina, and Luis Henrique has an adductor strain
description:
Inter should rest five before Fiorentina — Gazzetta expects as many as five changes at San Siro.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=53

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 23): Luis Henrique has a strain of the long adductor in his left thigh. The club set no return date.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 23): Maurizio Mariani referees. Kickoff 7:30 AM ET, 12:30 CET, Serie A matchday 8.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews (Oct 24): as many as five changes, with Carlos Augusto in for Dimarco and Esposito back in attack.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews (Oct 24): Ivan Provedel is set for his first Inter appearance.
